name: PageIndex
description: Indexes long documents as a reasoning-based hierarchical tree so agents retrieve by navigating structure instead of embedding similarity.

skills.name: Tree Index Generation
skills.description: Builds a hierarchical table-of-contents index over long documents that mirrors their actual section structure.

skills.name: Reasoning Retrieval
skills.description: Navigates the document tree by reasoning about which sections answer a query, with no embedding database required.

skills.name: Citation Tracing
skills.description: Returns the exact node and page a retrieved passage came from so answers stay traceable to the source document.
